state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: Lemma 1 (Impossibility). Let T be a training strategy on M* with distributions S, which may output any robustly capable agent on S with respect to the training utility U. If M* with S is ambiguous between the training utility U and a substantially divergent Ũ on S, then T may output an agent which goal misgeneralises on new distributions (not in S), optimising Ũ there instead.
title: Lemma 1: goal-misgeneralisation possibility
